يمتطيان (form VIII)
# يَمْتَطِيَانِ (yamtaṭiyāni) /jam.ta.tˤi.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# يُمْتَطَيَانِ (yumtaṭayāni) /jum.ta.tˤa.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
